how: We read the website of every Charleston wedding florist listed on Lazo (174 listings, 123 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: bridal gown shops, a tableware store, a floral-supply company for florists, venues and planners listed as florists, and beach-ceremony package sellers. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What holds up in Charleston heat and humidity for an outdoor ceremony, and what wilts by cocktail hour?
Do you design and install for the venue, or deliver arrangements? Installation and teardown are where the price moves.
Can I see a full wedding's florals at my budget, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: Festoon Charleston
picks.blurb: Festoon Charleston is a luxury wedding florist serving Charleston, Kiawah Island and the Lowcountry with garden-inspired designs. The studio treats flowers as storytellers, weaving blooms and textures so they feel gathered from a place rich with meaning.

picks.name: Fresh Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: Fresh Weddings and Events calls itself Charleston's go-to shop for wedding and event florals in a city hosting hundreds of weddings a month, and recently moved to a larger studio near the Avondale district in West Ashley. The site shows real weddings and walks through its process.

picks.name: Branch Flower Shop
picks.blurb: Branch Flower Shop is sisters Leslie and Sarah, who went into business after Leslie did the flowers for Sarah's wedding. Weddings and rehearsals are the Mt Pleasant shop's specialty, from large events to last-minute elopements, alongside daily delivery.

picks.name: Carolina Floral Creations
picks.blurb: Bali and Beth, lifelong friends who grew up in the Charleston area, found their love of floral design more than 20 years ago and have worked in the industry since. Carolina Floral Creations is a full-service wedding florist in Summerville, and the site explains bouquet shapes and choices.

picks.name: Petaloso
picks.blurb: Petaloso, named for an Italian child's invented word meaning full of petals, does floral productions for luxury events, onscreen work and immersive installations. Lori's Charleston studio treats each project as a one-of-a-kind work of art, and clients on the site describe her calm presence.

picks.name: Sweetleaf Floral
picks.blurb: Mara left public health research for floral design in 2018 and runs Sweetleaf Floral from Hollywood, with roots in Mt Pleasant and Edisto. Custom wedding and event florals across Charleston and the Lowcountry, with a process she describes as seamless, transparent and joyful.

picks.name: Loluma
picks.blurb: Loluma is a Charleston event design and production house with in-house floral, custom fabrication, a large rental and decor inventory and event planning. Since 2007 it has produced hundreds of social and corporate events in Charleston and around the country.

picks.name: Beau Soleil Weddings
picks.blurb: Beau Soleil Weddings has done wedding florals and design since 2010 for couples from around the country marrying on Myrtle Beach's Grand Strand. Floral, decor rental and design services for any style and budget, from a picked-from-the-garden bouquet to custom centerpieces, with a complimentary consultation.
